candidates.description: This vector represents common German verb lemmas and inflected forms.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, permission, or past and conditional states.
These tokens represent German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns used to introduce dependent clauses.
This vector activates on common German and Dutch prepositions.
This feature vector activates on common German noun and verb prefixes and root-word beginnings, particularly those starting with "ge-".
German possessive and definite determiners and pronouns inflected for case, gender, and number.
This vector represents proper nouns, monosyllabic words, and terms related to legislation or physical objects ending in a hard consonant sound.
This vector represents major sporting events, tournaments, and competitive athletic games across multiple languages.
These tokens represent common German adverbial and verbal prefixes, root morphemes, and prepositions.
This vector represents social organizations, venues, and associated group gatherings.
